leadText: Volume 11 is the eleventh volume published by VIZ Media compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and are collected independently of Shogakukan's collected releases of the magazine version.
plainText:
Volume 11 is the eleventh volume published by VIZ Media compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and are collected independently of Shogakukan's collected releases of the magazine version.

==Blurb==
Henry and Casey continue to search for the lost Rusted Sword and Rusted Shield as Henry trains the Kubfu, the Pokémon from the Isle of Armor. But a new danger presents itself...

Can our team figure out how to reverse the effects of Eternatus’s poison?!

==Publications==
 
 

==Chapters==
Adventure 32: Boom!! Reunion in a New Land
Adventure 33: Whoosh!! To the Forest of Focus
Adventure 34: BAAM!! Incredible Evolution of the Three Pokémon
